contents: Designed for generic automation: webhooks, HTTP requests, branching/logic, Python script execution, and AI LLM integrations
Decoupled so frontend and backend can evolve independently
Uses uv as the official Python package and virtual environment manager
SQLAlchemy 2.0 database engine supporting SQLite and PostgreSQL via DATABASE_URL, with scoped variables hierarchy and regex template interpolation
Canvas node drag auto-persistence with debounced sync to backend and VariablesModal for scoped variables CRUD

Flow folders classification, canonical multi-environment promotion pipeline (dev->qa->prd) with version incrementing and source_flow_id lineage, and 4-tier multi-environment scoped variables resolution hierarchy in FlowRunner
TopNav Environment Switcher (DEV/QA/PRD), FlowsModal folder grouping & promotion action buttons, and VariablesModal multi-environment selector

Multi-method webhook triggering (GET, POST, PUT, DELETE, PATCH, ANY) with query parameters ingestion for GET and fallback, method matching against WebhookTriggerComponent, and descriptive 405 Method Not Allowed handling
Conditional branch skipping in DAG runner cascading skips to downstream nodes of unselected true_branch or false_branch handles without failing flow execution
PaginatedHttpComponent implements async pagination loop supporting page_number, offset_limit, and cursor modes with break_condition and max_pages safety limit, returning consolidated all_items array
Pre-configured canvas templates if_condition_flow and paginated_api_flow in flowStore and TopNav, with skipped node badges in CustomNode and telemetry in ExecutionDrawer
Configurable webhook authentication modes (none, api_key_header, bearer, api_key_query) with customizable header and query param names, and 401 Unauthorized enforcement in FastAPI routes
FlowsModal webhook banner displays security badges and one-click Copiar cURL button generating executable commands with configured auth headers/params
